title: JAK'D Repeeled Mango Pineapple & Orange 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Mango, Pineapple & Orange from Jak’d and Re-Peeled is a vibrant blend that brings together the bold, tropical notes of Mango and Pineapple with the tangy zest of Orange. Savour this juicy medley of flavours that delivers a burst of sun-soaked tropical freshness, perfectly capturing the essence of summer in every puff. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Nicotine salts differ from regular freebase e-liquids due to their alkaline formulation, allowing for a higher nicotine concentration. Furthermore, nicotine from Nic Salt e-liquids is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, offering almost instantaneous relief from nicotine cravings. The unique magic of Nic Salts means that you’ll enjoy a super-smooth, comfortable throat hit despite the higher nicotine concentration. Designed for vapers who like to double down on flavour, Jak'd delivers more than just the usual e-liquid. Every bottle offers a robust, amplified taste that sets it apart in the market. For those ready to elevate their vaping experience to new heights, Jak'd e-liquids are inspired by some of the best flavours from such legendary brands as Jack Rabbit, Cyber Rabbit, Okay Orange!, Japanta and Unreal and are available in long-lasting 100ml Shortfills and super-satisfying Nic Salts.
